text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High tail latency detected on inference-cluster-a. Trigger: p99 token-latency > 5s and streaming stalls count increased. Alert rule: infra.inference.latency.p99 > 5s for 3m.

Maria (SRE): I'm on it. Pulling up dashboards and logs. p95 ~ 700ms, p99 ~ 6.1s for last 5m. Streaming stalls correlate with a specific node pool (gpu-pool-3).

Sanjay: seeing similar. Which ASG/nodes are in gpu-pool-3?

Kevin: gpu-pool-3 = nodes gpux-11,gpux-12,gpux-13 (A100s, heterogeneous firmware versions).

Miguel: looking at node-level telemetry — GPU ECC corrected errors spiking on gpux-12. Also GPU temperature thermal_throttle events in last 10m.

Maria (SRE): can you paste the GPU logs?

Miguel: paste below.
```
[2026-03-14T01:02:11Z] gpux-12: NVML ECC  corrected  count=428
[2026-03-14T01:03:07Z] gpux-12: NVML ECC  uncorrected count=2
[2026-03-14T01:04:50Z] gpux-12: thermal throttle  temp=92C  action=throttle
[2026-03-14T01:05:12Z] gpux-12: nvlink error   link=3  retries=5
```

Sanjay: uncorrected ECC + thermal throttle = bad. This can cause stalls as driver resets or kernel warnings trigger.

Lia (Support): customer impact? Any active sessions streaming from hosted-api?

Maria (SRE): yes, about 12% of streaming sessions in the last 15m were routed to gpu-pool-3 (regional routing policy). We are seeing degraded streaming completeness and longer tail latencies for affected requests. Suggest immediate mitigation: cordon & drain gpux-12, fail traffic over to gpux-11/gpux-13 and fallback variants.

Kevin: agree. Plan: 1) cordon gpux-12 2) drain pods (graceful) 3) scale up a temporary replacement node in same AZ or route to healthy pool 4) enable fallback model variant (cpu-quantized variant) for streaming calls to reduce stalls.

Maria (SRE): executing step 1/2 now.
```
kubectl cordon gpux-12
kubectl drain gpux-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

incident-bot: Note: Drain started by Maria (SRE) (action id: drain-1742001009-1).

Miguel: while draining, I see kernel logs: 
```
[gpux-12 kernel] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=1024 Threaded Interrupt
[gpux-12 kernel] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
```
That explains client stalls.

Sanjay: I'm prepping to scale up a replacement node (gpux-14). Will allocate with same instance type and latest drivers.

Kevin: Lia, please prepare a short status update for the status page and customers who might be in the affected org bucket. Recommend wording: degraded streaming and increased tail latency affecting a subset of requests in region eu-west-1. Engineers are draining a problematic GPU node and routing traffic to healthy nodes. ETA for mitigation: 20-30m.

Lia (Support): Drafting now, posting to status page and emailing top 10 impacted customers.

Maria (SRE): Drain finished. gpux-12 is cordoned and empty. Telemetry shows immediate drop in stalls for sessions routed away from gpu-pool-3. p99 dropped to ~2.1s, streaming stalls reduced by ~85% within 2 min.

Miguel: gpux-12 shows persistent ECC uncorrected and NVLINK errors — recommend decommissioning and hardware replacement. I'll open a ticket with infra-hardware and tag oncall-hardware.

Sanjay: gpux-14 provisioned and joined cluster, rebalanced pods. Routing rules updated to prefer gpu-pool-4 as hot spare.

incident-bot: Auto-rollback/protect policy triggered: temporarily bumped fallback-model routing to 30% for streaming endpoints to ensure stability.

Lia (Support): Status page updated. Messaging: "Mitigation in progress: affected requests are being routed away from a degraded GPU node. Customers may experience improved latency; full resolution depends on hardware replacement." :white_check_mark:

Kevin: quick ask — add a new alert for NVML ECC uncorrected > 0 sustained for 2m per node. This slipped through current infra alerts.

Maria (SRE): filing follow-up action items and RCA owner. Immediate owner: Miguel (hardware triage), Long-term: infra/firmware compatibility sweep.

Miguel: filing hardware ticket now with logs & ECC counts.

Maria (SRE): I'm handing off active monitoring to Sanjay — I need to step off for a scheduled meeting. Sanjay, can you take rotation?

oncall-rotation: @Sanjay is now on-call for incidents. Handoff note: active mitigation in progress, monitoring gpux-14 and cluster p99.

Sanjay: taking over. I'll keep watch for 30m and confirm p99 stable. If tail latency spikes again, I'll roll traffic to dedicated dedicated-hosted-fallback pool and contact infra-hardware.

Lia (Support): I'll keep customers updated with periodic notes. Please ping if any change in impact.

Maria (SRE): thanks team. Post-incident action items: 1) Replace gpux-12 hardware 2) Add NVML ECC uncorrected alert 3) Add thermal threshold alert and automated drain playbook 4) Review routing weights and fallback percentages for streaming.

Sanjay: noted. I'll own automated drain playbook.

Kevin: I'll track firmware/drivers and schedule a wave to standardize versions across gpu-pools.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigated — partial routing change and node drain completed. Root cause suspected: hardware degradation (ECC uncorrected + thermal throttling) causing GPU driver resets and streaming stalls. Continue monitoring.

Maria (SRE): closing thread for now; will reopen if anything regresses.
